source_span: with the rate on 10-year Japanese government notes touched 3% for the first time since 1996 ... and the 10-year Treasury rate hit levels last seen January last year
source_chain: Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks flip the burden of proof from 'why hike' to 'why not hike' (Mizuho, 15163) therefore the market prices ~64-70% odds of a September hike and ~60bp of tightening through mid-2027 (Mizuho/JPM) therefore long yields sell off globally — but the 'since 2008' magnitude is explicitly reserved for France's OAT and the global sovereign gauge (15120, 15218) and Japan's JGB (since 1996), while the US 10-year itself is only back to a level 'last seen January last year' — therefore the repricing is genuinely contested between DB's normalization framing (still +16% total return since the Oct-2023 yield peak) and a crowding-out/deficit/energy/AI-capex camp, with odds already reversing day to day (68%→63% per DB Reid, 9/3) on soft data, not fixed at a clean 60-70% floor.
pulse_chain: Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks flip the market to pricing a September hike as base case (Mizuho framing) therefore odds sit at 60-70% (JPM 64%, Mizuho 70%) with 60-65bp priced through mid-2027 therefore the 10-year Treasury at 4.75% is 'a level not seen since before the 2008 financial crisis,' alongside Japan's 3% (since 1996) and global yields at highest since mid-2008, therefore this is a historic, broad-based repricing contested between DB's normalization/16%-return bull case and a structurally-higher camp (deficits, energy, AI capex), with the hike camp winning near-term, resolved via Short $TLT invalidated only if the FOMC doesn't hike or Warsh softens tone.
why: The pulse assigns the 'not seen since before 2008' magnitude to the US 10-year Treasury specifically, but the source note reserves that framing for France's OAT and the global sovereign-bond gauge (with Japan getting its own since-1996 marker) and states outright that the US 10-year itself is only back to a level last seen roughly 19 months earlier — a materially different premise that inflates the scale of the very event the theme's causal chain is built on.
